newsitem.title: BELGIUM: King Albert visits NATO headquarters.
newsitem.headline: King Albert visits NATO headquarters.

text.p: Belgium's King Albert paid a formal visit on Friday to NATO's headquarters -- only a few kilometres from his own palace in the capital Brussels.

The King had a session with the alliance's 16 ambassadors and discussed how NATO's planned eastwards expansion could be undertaken without weakening the organisation that won the Cold War without firing a shot in anger.
"The King showed special interest in that subject, he specially requested the visit include a proper working session," a NATO official said.
